newsitem.title: UK: UBS leads 80 mln stg 3-tranche asset-backed FRN.
newsitem.headline: UBS leads 80 mln stg 3-tranche asset-backed FRN.

text.p: Craegmoor Finance Plc has issued an 80 million sterling asset-backed three-tranche floating-rate bond, lead manager UBS said.
AMT 51.2 MLN STG BASE *3M-LIBOR EXP MAT 31.DEC.06
TYPE FRN MARGIN 50 BP LEG MAT 31.DEC.08
FULL FEES 40 BP ISS PRICE PAR AVG LIFE 8.5 YEARS

TRANCHE B IS OFFERED FOR 11.2 MILLION STG, HAS AN AVERAGE LIFE OF 10 YEARS, PAYS A COUPON OF 3M-LIBOR +70 BP (STEPS-UP TO 20 BP AFTER 10 YEARS) AND ISSUE PRICE OF PAR. TRANCHE C IS OFFERED FOR 17.6 MILLION STG, HAS AN AVERAGE LIFE OF 10 YEARS, PAYS A COUPON OF 3M-LIBOR +125 (STEPS-UP TO 325 BP AFTER 10 YEARS) AND HAS AN ISSUE PRICE OF PAR.
